title: learn records a no-fix eval finding that was closed with --tried as fixed-since with its tried day, and querylog.py check rejects it
goal: Found in the review of SP-qzip6qar, item ST-mqb5lnam (querylog.py close --tried closes an eval finding apply left no-fix, and the stranded detector leaves it alone): when the question of a no-fix eval finding closed with --tried passes again, the fixed-since record learn writes (_tools/ql_learn.py) passes querylog.py check: it drops tried, or the store accepts it on that record.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import ql_learn, ql_store; prev = dict(id="F-0123456789ab", kind="eval", state="no-fix", stage="miss", entry="e1", tried="2026-10-01"); rec = dict(ql_learn._key(prev), state="fixed-since", observed=dict()); probs = ql_store.record_problems(rec, "w", set(["e1"]), None); print(probs); sys.exit(1 if any("tried" in x for x in probs) else 0)

gates.question: Which fix: learn drops tried from the fixed-since record of a no-fix eval finding, or the store accepts tried on it? Reason for dropping: tried notes a still-open attempt, a passing question leaves it no reader, and the store keeps one narrow test (gap, or no-fix eval).
options: store accepts tried on a fixed-since eval record

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import ql_learn, ql_store; prev = dict(id="F-0123456789ab", kind="eval", state="no-fix", stage="miss", entry="e1", tried="2026-10-01"); rec = dict(ql_learn._key(prev), state="fixed-since", observed=dict()); probs = ql_store.record_problems(rec, "w", set(["e1"]), None); print(probs); sys.exit(1 if any("tried" in x for x in probs) else 0)
